documents.title: Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Notice of Postal Ballot
Tech Mahindra Limited Has informed About Newspaper Advertisement Published Regarding The Notice Of Loss Of Share Certificates

analysis.summary: Tech Mahindra reported Q2 FY27 revenues of $1.693 billion, marking 7.2% year-on-year growth in constant currency, alongside an operating margin of 14.8%. Total deal wins for the quarter stood at $1.023 billion, supported by broad-based growth across verticals such as Communications and Retail, Transport and Logistics. Management highlighted ongoing progress in AI initiatives under Project Helix and announced a 1:1 bonus share issue alongside an interim dividend of INR 15 per share. Furthermore, the company reiterated its expectation to achieve its full-year FY27 EBIT margin target of 15%. Tech Mahindra reported its consolidated financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, registering a revenue of Rs 16,180 crores and a profit after tax of Rs 1,586 crores.

guidance.claim: The company reiterated its expectation to achieve its full-year FY27 EBIT margin target of 15%.
guidance.quote: We reiterate that we remain on track to achieve our full-year FY27 EBIT margin target of 15%.

guidance.claim: Management reiterated its stance to maintain 90% to 100% free cash flow to PAT on a full-year basis.
guidance.quote: We reiterate our stance to maintain 90% to 100% free cash flow to PAT on a full-year basis.

guidance.claim: Management remains confident in meeting or exceeding the goal of beating the peer average for the full financial year.
guidance.quote: On the whole, we feel we have a healthy order book for the remainder of the year, and barring any sort of unexpected and so far unforeseen macroeconomic developments, we remain confident that the growth momentum that we have set in the first quarter of the year will continue for the remainder of the year and that we will, you know, we will meet or exceed our goal of being ahead of peer average for the full financial year, as we already are in the first quarter of the financial year.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that they expect normal seasonality for the second half of the year.
Management expects a sequential revenue headwind associated with an automotive program in Q3 to a much smaller extent.
demand_outlook.quote: A sequential revenue headwind associated with the program is expected in Q3 as well, though to a much smaller extent.

demand_outlook.claim: Management highlighted healthy demand in areas such as payment modernization, wealth platforms, regulatory compliance, identity and access management, and AI-led transformation within the BFSI business.
demand_outlook.quote: We continue to see healthy demand in areas such as payment modernization, wealth platforms, regulatory compliance, identity and access management, and AI-led transformation.

demand_outlook.claim: The macroeconomic environment for the retail, travel, and logistics vertical remains mixed.
demand_outlook.quote: While the macroeconomic environment for this vertical remains mixed, our tailored offerings and focused client engagement approach are gaining traction and we remain positive about the direction of the business.

demand_outlook.claim: Management observed challenges to demand in manual testing, traditional big data, standalone e-commerce, legacy CRM, and legacy infrastructure administration.
demand_outlook.quote: Areas where we are seeing challenges to demand are sort of as you would expect in the manual testing area in your traditional big data area, in standalone e-commerce, in legacy CRM and legacy infra admin.

capex_expansion.claim: The company established the Toronto Innovation Hub to bring together client co-creation and AI innovation.
capex_expansion.quote: We established the Toronto Innovation Hub to bring together client co-creation and AI innovation.

capex_expansion.claim: The company launched the Engineering Experience Center to help organizations move faster from concept to commercialization of their products.
capex_expansion.quote: Additionally, we launched the Engineering Experience Center to help organizations move faster from concept to commercialization of their products.

capex_expansion.claim: Tech Mahindra announced the acquisition of Avant Techno Solutions, a Canada-based firm specializing in payments modernization and wealth platforms.
capex_expansion.quote: During the quarter, we also announced the acquisition of Avant Techno Solutions, a Canada-based firm specializing in payments modernization and wealth platforms.

margins_costs.claim: Operating margins for the quarter stood at 14.8%.
margins_costs.quote: Operating margins for the quarter stood at 14.8%.

margins_costs.claim: EBIT for the quarter stood at US$250 million with an EBIT margin of 14.8%, up 40 basis points on a Q-o-Q basis and 260 basis points on a Y-o-Y basis.
margins_costs.quote: EBIT for the quarter stood at US$250 million with an EBIT margin of 14.8%, up 40 basis points on a Q-o-Q basis and 260 basis points on a Y-o-Y basis.

margins_costs.claim: Operating margins for the quarter stood at 14.4%, up 60 basis points quarter-on-quarter and 330 basis points year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: EBIT margins for the quarter were at US$238 million with EBIT percent at 14.4%, up 60 bps Q-o-Q and 330 basis points Y-o-Y.

margins_costs.claim: Margin expansion was led by volume growth and savings from Project Fortius, partially offset by Comviva seasonality and business mix.
margins_costs.quote: The margin expansion was led by volume growth and savings from Project Fortius, partially offset by Comviva seasonality and business mix.

orders_capacity.claim: Total deal wins for the quarter were US$1.023 billion.
orders_capacity.quote: Coming to deal wins, our total deal wins for the quarter were US$1.023 billion.

orders_capacity.claim: On a last-12-month basis, deal wins stand at US$4,270 million, up 34.8% year-on-year.
orders_capacity.quote: On a last-12-month basis, deal wins stand at US$4,270 million, up 34.8% Y-o-Y.

orders_capacity.claim: New deal wins TCV for the quarter stood at $1,023 million, up 25.4% year-on-year.
orders_capacity.quote: • New deal wins TCV $1,023 mn, up 25.4% YoY

capital_allocation.claim: The board of directors recommended a bonus share issue in a ratio of 1:1 for shareholders.
capital_allocation.quote: As we mark this milestone, I'm also pleased to announce that our Board of Directors has recommended a bonus share issue in a ratio of 1:1 for our shareholders.

capital_allocation.claim: The board declared an interim dividend of INR 15 per share.
capital_allocation.quote: The board has declared an interim dividend of INR15 per share, reaffirming our commitment to the laid-out capital allocation policy of returning 85% and above of free cash flow back to shareholders.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board declared an interim dividend of Rs 15 per equity share for the Financial Year 2026-27.
capital_allocation.quote: Declared Interim Dividend of Rs. 15/- per equity share of the face value of Rs. 5/- each (300%) for the Financial Year 2026-27.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended the issue of bonus equity shares in the ratio of 1:1.
capital_allocation.quote: Issue of Bonus Equity Shares in the ratio of 1:1, i.e. one (1) new fully paid-up Bonus Equity Share of Rs. 5/- each for every one (1) existing fully paid-up equity share of Rs. 5/- each, held by the Eligible Members of the Company as on the Record date set for this purpose, by capitalisation of amounts standing to the credit of the Securities Premium Account and/or General Reserves and/or Retained Earnings and/or any other permitted Reserves, as per the Audited Financial Statements of the Company for the financial year ended 31 March 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: The Authorised Share Capital of the Company was increased from Rs 924.3 crore to Rs 1,000 crore.
capital_allocation.quote: Increase in the Authorised Share Capital of the Company from Rs. 924.3 crore to Rs. 1,000 crore, and consequent amendment to the existing Clause V(a) of the Memorandum of Association of the Company.

capital_allocation.claim: The company generated US$167 million of free cash flow during the quarter, representing a 94% increase year-on-year.
capital_allocation.quote: We generated US$167 million of free cash flow during the quarter, up 94% on a Y-o-Y basis.

risks_headwinds.claim: Manufacturing revenue declined 3.9% sequentially against a higher prior-quarter base following the accelerated execution of a large European automotive program.
risks_headwinds.quote: Manufacturing revenue declined 3.9% sequentially against a higher prior-quarter base following the accelerated execution of a large European automotive program in the prior quarter, which I'd mentioned last time.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that memory prices and chip prices are increasing significantly.
risks_headwinds.quote: As you know, memory prices and chip prices are increasing significantly, and we are not willing to guarantee those for the customer, right?

management_commitments.claim: Completion of middleware for India's indigenous 20-qubit trapped-ion quantum computer is expected by December 2026.
management_commitments.quote: Completion is expected by December 2026, with commercialization activities expected thereafter.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to introduce AI revenue reporting as part of H2 FY27 disclosures.
management_commitments.quote: We expect to introduce AI revenue reporting as part of our H2 FY27 disclosures and continue it on an ongoing basis, refining the methodology as our portfolio and the markets mature.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to ensure 200 engineers get trained in the next quarter on deep techniques to hone models and harnesses.
management_commitments.quote: We have curated a special internal course to ensure 200 engineers get trained in the next quarter on some deep techniques to hone models and harnesses.

management_commitments.claim: The interim dividend shall be paid by 13 November 2026 through electronic mode.
management_commitments.quote: The Interim Dividend shall be paid by 13 November 2026 through electronic mode to those Members or their mandates:

management_commitments.claim: Wage increases are expected to take effect in a phased fashion starting in the second quarter.
management_commitments.quote: As far as the wage piece is concerned, we expect to be able to announce it effective Q2, obviously in a phased fashion which we will be announcing, to our employees in the days to come, so that will be effective, it'll start becoming effective Q2 in a phased fashion.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
